limitations: Input dependency does not establish prognostic benefit or a causal effect.
Positive permutation-minus-original NLL means this single permutation worsened the score; the opposite direction means it improved. Neither direction alone establishes reliable CT1 benefit.
These are already used inner-validation partitions and selected checkpoints. Patient exposures across folds and arms are not independent clinical observations.
One fixed available-patient permutation per checkpoint is descriptive; no permutation uncertainty or retraining uncertainty is estimated.
Common K64 and MC seed17 apply to every checkpoint. Antithetic draws are paired simulation units, not additional patients.
